# ZIMR POLYMARKET BRIEFING | Thursday, May 28, 2026

## Market Says: Iran Deal Dead, Esports Money Flowing, Trump Dance Forgotten

The market has decisively closed the book on near-term US-Iran diplomacy. Permanent peace deal odds collapsed 14% to just 8% for May 31, with $7.7M in volume—the day's heaviest action. Extension agreements fared worse, dropping to 16%, signaling traders see **zero momentum** for the May 31 deadline. This isn't gradual fade; this is capitulation. Smart money exited simultaneously across all Iran pairs, suggesting a single catalyst shifted positioning hard (likely failed closed-door talks or leaked intel on negotiations).

Esports is eating. LoL's SOOPers-Red Force Game 1 exploded to 99% (+70%), pulling $891K in what looks like pre-game squeeze or sharp money confident in a blowout. The BO3 market sits inverted at 1%, creating arbitrage opportunities if you're reading the series differently than the market. Roland Garros ATP also showing technical strength—Cobolli at 97% is price-discovery heavy, no surprises.

The Trump dance market is dead (1% odds, -27%), which tells you retail exhaustion on novelty bets. The real signal: **geopolitics dumped, sports confidence rose**—classic risk-off to risk-on in micro markets.

---

## WATCH LIST

**1. US x Iran permanent peace deal by May 31** [8%, $7.7M vol]  
Why: Watch for after-hours news or weekend leaks. If odds spike back above 15%, you'll see cascading liquidations in related pairs. This is the canary.

**2. LoL: SOOPers vs Red Force BO3** [1%, $1.4M vol]  
Why: Sharp disconnect between Game 1 (99%) and series outcome (1%). If Red Force takes Game 1, this corrects violently. High-leverage spot.

**3. Will Bitcoin hit $150k by June 30** [1%, $5.8M vol]  
Why: Lowest odds, highest volume—classic contrarian signal. Post-Iran capitulation, watch if risk appetite returns and this pops.
